The picture is set at <image3>: A crossroads of two narrow London streets at three o'clock of a black winter morning. Tall soot-dark brick terraces line both streets, every window shuttered and dark. Cast-iron gas lamps stand at intervals along each kerb, their flames burning yellow; the nearest lamp stands on the corner itself, throwing hard yellow light down from the upper right onto the wet cobbles and long black shadows toward the lower left. The cross street runs away downhill between its own row of lamps. Granite kerbstones, black iron railings before the basement areas, and an iron drain grating at the corner complete the junction. A black night sky hangs above the rooftops. Lamplight glows through the window at the LEFT, deep shadow.. The establishing wide looks along the eastward street from its west end at head height.
